fields.statement: At 12a2ea4, go test ./internal/api -run TestProgramStatusReviewCodeCheck -v -count=1 passes: it runs the builtin review shape (command step code running rhiza run code-check, on.pass to the checks step) over a fake runner whose command exits 1, with Rex reporting wired as run.start wires it into a buffer, and logs exactly two root reports: state=working msg="step code", then state=error msg="run failed: step \"code\" ended with outcome \"fail\""; the test asserts both. The diff only adds that test. make check (with RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset) exits 0.
